search.snippet: Marigold seeds can be planted in a flower patch at level 2 Farming to yield marigolds, which are used to make imp repellent or as payment to protect hammerstone hops. When fully grown, it protects potato, onion, and tomato plants in neighbouring allotments from disease.

search.snippet: A marigold seed is used in the Farming skill to grow Marigolds. They may be obtained by pickpocketing Master Farmers stealing them from Olivia s seed stall in Draynor Village or purchasing them from either Olivias Draynor Seed Market or Coeden s seed store.
search.title: How To Farm Marigold Osrs - Farm Info Mania

search.snippet: Sowing marigold seeds is quite easy and they can also be started in seed trays or pots. Sow in spring when temps are 10-25 deg Celsius.

search.snippet: They are a very important resource to collect in Len's Island as seeds allow you to start farming crops and become self sufficient with keeping your hunger at bay. Collected seeds can also be kept in a Seed Storage which can be unlocked over time at the Workbench.

intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market is in a normal patch window with subdued price pressure and elevated breadth. Turnover is modestly positive while liquidity stress remains elevated, and the shallowest book depth is concentrated in high-spread, low-volume names.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and range-bound; participants are prioritizing cost of entry and fill probability over aggressive reversion, producing low-volatility, low-alpha conditions.
intelligence.regime: Normal patch window (not an update cycle); deterministic news flow is quiet, macro/microstructure metrics indicate a compressed risk-appetite regime.
intelligence.research_summary: Deterministic setup implies price discovery is rule-driven; cross-wallet edges arise from differential risk-budgeting and microstructure timing rather than exogenous news. Current regime favors strategies with tight spread capture, low inventory risk, and high fill probability.
